title: Tooling: 2.29× faster production HPE transport via integer rows with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production `research/complex-k492-owner-repair/code/hpe_audit_and_transport.py` still stored every scalar row as a dictionary of `Fraction` values. Wronskode’s opt-in adapter `research/hpe-audit-fast-seed93/` (incorporated [#1137](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1137)) already proved shared-denominator sparse integer rows with identical complete transport receipts. This PR wires that equivalent rewrite into the **production** k492 transport auditor used by changed-word tooling.

SELECTED-SOURCE-bound `research/complex-sw4-frame8/local/hpe_audit_and_transport.py` copies are intentionally left pairwise so the selected inventory stays untouched. Dependent packages that previously live-pinned the k492 path retarget to that sw4 transport. Distinct from [#2357](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2357) (`hpe_audit_local.py`) and from [#2409](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2409) (PR635-path production integer rows).

No certificate κ pins change.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with `taskset -c 0`, five alternating fresh-process pairs over the five honest frontier1042 layer-end words gave median wall time **6.452 → 2.816 s (2.29×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every honest and fuzz outcome matches the pairwise baseline.

Package: `research/hpe-transport-integer-production/`.
Tip: `7452a6ce9b79dee2e2b0d2a8819c4d4099d302e2`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/hpe-transport-integer-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/hpe-transport-integer-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-transport-integer-production
python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_hpe_transport_integer_production
taskset -c 0 python3.12 -I -B research/hpe-transport-integer-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_HPE_TRANSPORT_INTEGER_PRODUCTION assertions=26 honest=5 fuzz=20 corruption=receipt_divergence certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/hpe-transport-integer-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_HPE_TRANSPORT_INTEGER_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy ADD-drop foil rejects via audit failure or receipt divergence. Package gates under `-O` still load checkers with `compile(..., optimize=0)`. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): Wronskode’s `research/hpe-audit-fast-seed93/` / [#1137](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1137) (opt-in integer rows; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2357](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2357) (integer rows for `hpe_audit_local.py`, different object). Leave-alone tooling through [#2409](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2409) was not reopened. No competing open PR on production k492 `hpe_audit_and_transport.py` at refresh.

Credit Wronskode, icekylinx, and the retained transport-auditor lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
